text:
Priya (People Ops): @Carlos quick heads-up — candidate for Senior Infra (EMEA-based) asked if we can classify them as US remote for benefits so they get US health coverage from day 1. Hiring manager also requested a band uplift to S4 vs the posted S3. Need advice on routing and docs to attach.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): They can’t wait long — candidate asked for 2026-04-01 start and has another offer. If we can’t move band up, we risk losing them. Can we expedite? :grimacing:
Ben (Recruiter): Candidate accepted verbally pending confirmation. Holding for 72h. Offer terms proposed: base €110,000 + €10k sign-on (50/50 split), standard equity. Requested US benefits purely for provider network reasons — currently lives in Dublin but has frequent travel to SF.
Sana (Compensation): A few constraints: we don’t normally map EMEA hires to US bands. Exception requires Global HR + Finance signoff (impacts payroll, tax withholding, benefits vendor). To expedite we need: passport + proof of US tax residency OR explicit business justification + exec signoff.
Priya (People Ops): Routing I suggest: Compensation -> Finance (payroll ops) -> Global HR -> Legal. If we get docs today I can kick off approval now. Link to expedited form: https://redwood-internal/hr/approvals/new?case=2761234567 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
legal-bot: Reminder: cross-border classification may trigger different withholding and benefits eligibility. Please attach candidate's residency docs and a brief memo on business rationale. Use template: /legal/templates/crossborder-benefits.md
Carlos (Hiring Manager): I’ll ask candidate for passport + recent utility bill now. Also attaching manager note: role requires regular 3-week SF visits. Will sign if comp approves.
Sana (Compensation): If you want S4 we’ll need a comp committee exception. Please include comparable comps and why S3 is insufficient. I can review ASAP once form + docs are in.
Ben (Recruiter): Candidate said they can provide docs by EOD local time. I’ll upload to the form and tag you, @Sana.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks. I created ticket HR-2026-1457 and started prefill with candidate name and offer. I’ll route to Compensation now and cc Finance. If Compensation approves, I’ll escalate to Global HR + Legal for signatures. Expect first pass within 24-48h if we have complete docs.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): Appreciate it — please ping me if we hit any blocker. We’re flexible on sign-on timing (could frontload) if that helps procurement of talent.
Sana (Compensation): Noted — frontloaded sign-on makes comp committee more amenable if business case is strong. I’ll take a look as soon as the docs are in.
Priya (People Ops): Closing loop: I’ll post updates in this thread when each approval step completes. If anyone has follow-up evidence (medical plan preference, vendor contact), drop it here. :white_check_mark:
